---
title: "Registration"
---

Participation is free of charge. The two days have separate registrations.

## Tutorial, 22 March

Places are limited and participants are selected on the basis of a short motivation statement.
Applicants can also register for the colloquium in the same form.
[Apply for the tutorial](https://ecofast2027-tutorial.sciencesconf.org).

## Colloquium, 23 March

Open to all. [Register for the colloquium](https://ecofast2027.sciencesconf.org).
